# Gerard Baudains

Gerard Baudains is a former States Member, first elected to the States of Jersey in 1998.

Gerard Baudains has participated in 8 elections since 2002:

- [**2002 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/gerard-baudains#e3)

  Elected as Deputy of St Clement with 50% of the ballot.
- [**2005 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/gerard-baudains#e7)

  Elected as Deputy of St Clement with 67.7% of the ballot.
- [**2008 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/gerard-baudains#e11)

  Not elected.

  - [2008 Full Manifesto](http://jerseyelections.info/constables/gerard-baudains.html)
- [**2008 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/gerard-baudains#e12)

  Not elected.
- [**2010 Senator By-Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/gerard-baudains#e13)

  Not elected.

  - [2010 Full Manifesto](http://news.bbc.co.uk/local/jersey/hi/people_and_places/the_states/newsid_8721000/8721443.stm)
- [**2011 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/gerard-baudains#e15)

  Elected as Deputy of St Clement with 37.7% of the ballot.

  - [2011 Vote.je Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20111017043439/http://www.vote.je:80/candidates/deputies/st-clement/gerard-baudains/)
  - [2011 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20110928140604/http://www.channel103.com:80/election/?page_id=89)
- [**2014 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/gerard-baudains#e20)

  Not elected.

  - [2014 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2014/gerard-baudains/)
- [**2018 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/gerard-baudains#e41)

  Not elected.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/gerard-baudains-2/)

## Election History

**Gerard Baudains was elected as Deputy of St Clement in 2002**.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Mike Taylor](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/mike-taylor)** |  | 1,024 | 63.1% |
| 2 | **Gerard Baudains** |  | 811 | 50% |
| 3 | [Mike Stayte](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/mike-stayte) |  | 561 | 34.6% |
| 4 | [John Pirouet](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/john-pirouet) |  | 425 | 26.2% |
| 5 | [Michael Green](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/michael-green) |  | 163 | 10% |

1,622 ballots (inc. 15 spoilt papers)
